inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s talk of “success” and political resolution looks like cover, not a genuine shift: the operation and pressure on Iran are meant to continue. Israel’s refusal to bend on Iran’s nuclear and missile programs gives the game away. The peace language keeps the public focused on a managed story while the real question—who benefits from the operation dragging on—stays out of view.
